events.title: Demo Update Ahead of Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Hi everyone!I’ve recently made some updates to the demo, including:A new UI: I hope the updated interface makes your time with the game feel more immersive.A new item and Prestige skills: The Buzzsaw joins the action to help you destroy the world! events.title: Spin Your Tops. Break the World——Incretop Demo is release now!
events.summary: Spin Your Tops. Break the World. The Incretop Demo Is Out Now!Hi everyone! The demo for Incretop, an incremental game about spinning tops, is now available. Come give it a spin!It all starts with a whip. Keep your tops spinning to earn coins, then invest in upgrades, skills, and items to push things further. events.title: Incretop Playtest Now Open
events.summary: The playtest for Incretop is now available.Incretop is a short incremental physics game about whipping spinning tops, earning gold, upgrading your setup, buying strange interactive items, and slowly breaking the world apart.A typical playtest run takes around 20-30 minutes. During the test, you will:Whip tops to keep them spinningEarn gold through motion, collisions, and item effectsBuy upgrades to make your tops stronger, faster, and more chaoticUnlock playful field items and interact with them
